_comment: C0-14 luma bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」4 行带 .md 链接（runway/veo/pika/midjourney），related 写 4 条。sources 3 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: In-house Dream Machine video model line (official-site narrative); plus the Ray model line (seen on the official site). Users do not pick bare models. An open-weights line — no official statement verified.
axes.runtime: Web (lumalabs.ai) + API (an API entry on the official site, details not verified item by item); generation on the vendor's cloud. The company started in NeRF/3D capture (the original-Luma narrative); video generation became the main product line later.
axes.local_files: Works stored account-side in the cloud, generation history visible on the web works page; downloads go local. No officially stated local data surface.
axes.background: Generation is instant/queued (varies by tier, not verified item by item); no "keep-running-after-shutdown" task surface (no claim verified).
axes.tools: Text-to-video, image-to-video, keyframe interpolation (first/last frames, per the official narrative), Modify/extend editing lines (seen on the official site); the 3D/NeRF capture line is still a visible product surface on the official site (alongside the video line).
axes.context: Organized via the account works page (generation history reviewable); cross-session memory — no official statement verified. First/last-frame control is an in-task constraint, not cross-task memory.
axes.permissions: Account + subscription system (D9: prices not collected); the training-use switch not verified line by line; free-tier commercial and watermark limits follow the terms (not verified line by line).
axes.fit: Fits: short-film generation with strong camera motion (the official lead narrative), first/last-frame control, mixed 3D-capture-and-video workflows. Does not fit: mainland direct connection (measured 000), a long-narrative character-consistency focus, open weights.

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creative products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **Motion plausibility of first/last-frame interpolation** (whether complex actions break down)
- **The capability gap between the API and the web tiers**
- **The interlock surface between the 3D-capture line and the video line**
unknowns:
- The open-weights line (no official statement verified)
- API billing and quota surfaces (D9: prices not collected; not verified item by item)
- The training-use switch (not verified line by line)
- Cross-session memory mechanism (no official statement verified)
related: Both overseas professional-oriented video benches: Runway has deeper editing workflows, Luma a stronger generation narrative.
Both camera-narrative oriented: Veo hangs on the Google ecosystem, Luma is a standalone site.
Both lightweight overseas entries: Pika leans playful effects, Luma leans camera-move narrative.
Image-to-video upstream: Luma's first-frame workflow often starts from a Midjourney image.
